about_the_game:
Celebrate WrestleMania 41 with four exciting items based on the spectacle and Superstars of WrestleMania 41, available Summer 2025. Items include:

•WrestleMania 41 Arena

•MyFACTION Persona Card: New playable Superstar (TBA)

•MyFACTION Persona Card: WrestleMania Main Event #1 (TBA)

•MyFACTION Persona Card: WrestleMania Main Event #2 (TBA)

The WrestleMania 41 Pack is included as part of the WWE 2K25 The Bloodline Edition. The exact release date of the WrestleMania 41 Pack content is to be announced post-launch and subject to change.
